parts.title: Swimming Lessons
parts.transcript: S1: man phones City Swim School. Water Babies (example) for 3-months+: water familiarisation using toys (1); 3.80/lesson Tue mornings. Beginners: breathing (2) techniques, eyes underwater, swim 5m. Intermediate: main strokes, introduction to diving (3), underwater swimming, (water) safety (4) in the water; 61/course (10 lessons); max 12 pupils; class is for adults (5). Advanced: more efficient techniques, improving speed (6), competitions. Other: Intermediate begins Tuesday January 13 (7, register by Jan 8); 7.30pm; provided with a swimming hat (8); bring change/20p for the locker (9). Benefits: health, improvement in confidence (10), could save a life.

parts.title: Economics and Trust
parts.transcript: S4: lecture on oxytocin and trust. Trust in strangers relies on their kindness (31). Understanding trust can reduce poverty (32, more support/resources). Measuring trust links to people's ability of recognising a person's face (33). Oxytocin is released whenever interaction occurs between people (34). Trust game: the second participant has no obligation to return the money (35). Trust involves a process, so it is conditional (36). Animals that show cooperation are seen to have oxytocin (37, e.g. monkeys). Nash equilibrium: each participant has no expectations the other will change their decision (38). People under a lot of stress have higher levels of oxytocin (39). Oxytocin is like a social glue for bonding (40).
